summary: John's 2nd cousin 4x removed; Kingston merchant, Yale 1884.
bio: Nelson George Pringle (1860-1908), son of Alexander J. Pringle; Kingston merchant; Yale class of 1884. His daughters Elizabeth H. and Bertha A. Pringle graduated from Vassar in 1913 and 1916 (3rd cousins 3x removed).
